{"judgements":[{"id":"clo-po-nurs-aligned","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO performs nursing procedures safely using the nursing process, matching the PO's verb, level and subject.","sourceQuote":"safe, quality nursing care","targetQuote":"Perform basic nursing procedures safely using the nursing process","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":""},{"id":"clo-po-nurs-unrelated","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO is about calculus, not nursing. It has no nursing action, no safe-care competency and no nursing process, so it fails the subject test and shows no equivalent of the PO's verb.","sourceQuote":"Provide safe, quality nursing care to individuals using the nursing process.","targetQuote":"Compute the derivative of polynomial functions.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Perform basic nursing procedures safely on a simulated patient using the steps of the nursing process."},{"id":"d-po-05","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"Safe oral medication administration is nursing care at Apply level, but the CLO never mentions the nursing process (assess, diagnose, plan, implement, evaluate). It also covers only individual patients, not the families and communities the PO names.","sourceQuote":"Apply the nursing process in providing safe, quality care to individuals, families and communities.","targetQuote":"Prepare and administer oral medications safely following the five rights of medication administration.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Apply the nursing process to prepare and administer oral medications safely following the five rights, and teach the patient and family about the medication."},{"id":"d-po-06","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO only identifies heart anatomy (Remember). It has no therapeutic communication, no collaboration with the health team, and a lower Bloom level than the PO's Apply-level communication.","sourceQuote":"Communicate therapeutically with clients and collaboratively with the health team.","targetQuote":"Identify the anatomical structures of the heart.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Remember","draft":"Communicate therapeutically with a simulated client about a cardiac condition and report findings collaboratively to the health team."},{"id":"d-po-12","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO applies the nursing process to vital signs and is at Apply level. However, the PO asks for computing and mathematics knowledge, and the CLO shows no computation, calculation or use of computing tools. It shares only the Apply verb and the nursing context.","sourceQuote":"Apply knowledge of computing and mathematics appropriate to the discipline.","targetQuote":"Apply the nursing process to assess a patient's vital signs.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Apply basic mathematics and computing skills to calculate, record and interpret a patient's vital signs, such as pulse rate and respiratory rate, using the nursing process."},{"id":"d-ega-03","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO designs and evaluates a community outreach activity for a local health need, which fits social responsiveness and is at Create/Evaluate level. However, it does not mention stewardship, meaning responsible and sustainable care for people and resources. It also does not say who is served or how the activity responds to that community's needs. The subject is also not tied to fundamentals of nursing practice.","sourceQuote":"Socially Responsive Steward","targetQuote":"Design a community outreach activity that addresses a local health need and evaluate its results.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Create","draft":"Design a community health outreach activity on basic nursing care, such as hygiene or safety, that responsibly addresses a local health need, and evaluate its results and use of resources."},{"id":"d-ega-07","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO has professional-standard nursing performance and names the Augustinian values of community and truth.","sourceQuote":"Competent Catholic Augustinian-Marian Professional","targetQuote":"Augustinian values of community and truth in patient care","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":""},{"id":"d-ilo-04","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"Hand hygiene is a basic nursing procedure and a smaller step toward the CLO, at Apply level.","sourceQuote":"Perform basic nursing procedures safely","targetQuote":"Demonstrate correct hand hygiene","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":""},{"id":"d-ilo-05","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"Reciting nursing history is a Remember task. It is not a step toward performing procedures safely and does not build toward Apply. It is about history, not the CLO's procedural subject.","sourceQuote":"Perform basic nursing procedures safely using the nursing process on a simulated patient.","targetQuote":"Recite the history of nursing in the Philippines.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Remember","draft":"Demonstrate correct hand hygiene before and after contact with a simulated patient as part of a basic nursing procedure."},{"id":"d-po-13","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO is about the nursing process, which is the PO's subject, but it only describes the steps (Understand), which is below the PO's Apply level. It does not show safe, quality care delivery or care for individuals, families or communities.","sourceQuote":"Apply the nursing process in providing safe, quality care to individuals, families and communities.","targetQuote":"Describe the steps of the nursing process.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Understand","draft":"Apply the steps of the nursing process to provide safe, quality care to an individual and his or her family in a simulated case."},{"id":"d-ilo-15","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The ILO is on the same subject (vital signs) but only defines the term (Remember). The CLO requires accurate assessment at Apply level, so the ILO does not build toward the CLO's skill.","sourceQuote":"Assess vital signs accurately.","targetQuote":"Define the term vital signs.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Remember","draft":"Measure and record temperature, pulse, respiration and blood pressure accurately on a simulated patient."}]}

{"judgements":[{"id":"d-po-07","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO covers constructing (Create) a table of specifications and writing test items, which fits 'design' of assessments in the right subject. But the PO also asks for 'implement' and 'evaluate'; the CLO has no administering of the assessment and no evaluation of its quality or of the learning it measures (e.g. item analysis, validity or reliability review). Evaluate level is not reached.","sourceQuote":"Design, implement and evaluate assessments that measure student learning.","targetQuote":"Construct a table of specifications and write test items that match the stated learning objectives.","sourceBloom":"Evaluate","targetBloom":"Create","draft":"Construct a table of specifications and write test items that match the stated learning objectives, administer the test to a class, and evaluate its quality and the learning it measures through item analysis and validity and reliability checks."},{"id":"d-po-08","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"Discussing the history of educational testing is Understand level, below the Create/Evaluate level of the PO. It has no designing, implementing or evaluating of assessments, and the subject (history of testing) is not the PO's object of action, assessments that measure student learning.","sourceQuote":"Design, implement and evaluate assessments that measure student learning.","targetQuote":"Discuss the history of educational testing.","sourceBloom":"Evaluate","targetBloom":"Understand","draft":"Design, administer and evaluate classroom tests and performance tasks that measure student learning, using evidence from the results to judge their validity and to improve teaching."},{"id":"d-ega-05","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"Reflecting and setting goals for professional development expresses transformative lifelong learning.","sourceQuote":"Transformative Lifelong learner","targetQuote":"Reflect on one's own learning and set goals","sourceBloom":"Evaluate","targetBloom":"Evaluate","draft":""},{"id":"d-ilo-06","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"Writing multiple-choice items with plausible distractors is a smaller step toward constructing valid classroom tests.","sourceQuote":"Construct valid and reliable classroom tests.","targetQuote":"Write multiple-choice items with plausible distractors.","sourceBloom":"Create","targetBloom":"Create","draft":""},{"id":"d-ilo-07","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"Computing the mean and standard deviation is related, as test statistics are used to check reliability and interpret scores. But it is an Apply-level calculation that does not build toward constructing tests, and it is not linked to validity or reliability. It does not say how the statistics are used to judge or improve a test.","sourceQuote":"Construct valid and reliable classroom tests.","targetQuote":"Compute the mean and standard deviation of a set of test scores.","sourceBloom":"Create","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Compute the mean and standard deviation of a set of test scores and use them to judge the reliability of a classroom test and decide how to revise its items."},{"id":"d-po-14","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO is on the right subject (the code of ethics for teachers) but only asks to 'name' provisions, which is Remember level. The PO asks to demonstrate professional and ethical teaching practice, which is Apply level or higher. No demonstrating, and no application of the provisions to teaching or assessment situations, is shown.","sourceQuote":"Demonstrate professional and ethical teaching practice.","targetQuote":"Name the provisions of the code of ethics for professional teachers.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Remember","draft":"Apply the provisions of the code of ethics for professional teachers to demonstrate ethical practice in classroom assessment, such as fair grading and confidentiality of student results."}]}

{"judgements":[{"id":"d-po-09","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO has 'record' and 'report' and covers the right subject (receivables and inventories under reporting standards). It omits 'measure', which the PO requires. Its verbs also do not clearly reach Apply, since it never says the standards are applied to transactions.","sourceQuote":"record, measure and report financial transactions","targetQuote":"Record and report receivables and inventories","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Apply the applicable Philippine Financial Reporting Standards to record, measure and report receivables and inventories."},{"id":"d-po-10","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"'Define accounting' is Remember level, below the PO's Apply level. It builds toward no part of the CLO.","sourceQuote":"Record and report receivables in accordance with the applicable financial reporting standards.","targetQuote":"Explain the history of the accounting profession.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Understand","draft":"Record receivables, including uncollectible accounts, in accordance with the applicable Philippine Financial Reporting Standards."}]}

{"judgements":[{"id":"d-po-11","label":"ALIGNED","explanation":"The CLO applies food handling and sanitation procedures in guest service, matching the PO's verb, level and subject.","sourceQuote":"Apply safety, sanitation and hygiene standards","targetQuote":"Apply proper food handling and sanitation procedures","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":""},{"id":"d-ilo-10","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The ILO is a smaller step of table service in the same subject. But it only covers setting a cover (a single task), not the delivery of service. The ILO verb 'Set' is Apply, which builds toward 'Deliver'. As a CLO-level statement, it claims less than the CLO: it omits serving guests and the industry standards. The ILO text is also missing the standard being met beyond 'standard layout'. Since the source is the CLO and the target is the ILO, the ILO is a valid smaller step but does not state the industry standard or service delivery.","sourceQuote":"Deliver table service to industry standards.","targetQuote":"Set a cover for a three-course meal following the standard layout.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Set a cover for a three-course meal and serve it to guests following industry-standard table service procedures."},{"id":"d-ilo-11","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"The ILO contradicts the CLO: handling food with bare hands violates sanitation standards. It does not apply safety or sanitation standards, and it prioritises speed over hygiene. It is not a step toward the CLO's verb 'Apply' with respect to standards, and does not address beverages.","sourceQuote":"Apply safety and sanitation standards when serving food and beverages.","targetQuote":"Handle food with bare hands to save time during rush hours.","sourceBloom":"Apply","targetBloom":"Apply","draft":"Apply safe food-handling and sanitation standards, such as handwashing and using gloves or tongs, when serving food and beverages, including during rush hours."}]}
